_doc: Colour of the film over FILM time (17_制作规范.md §5; user's idea 2026-10-10: the emotion curve makes small colour adjustments). Two layers: (1) base palettes that switch HARD at story turning points (like the references, which change colour at structure points, not by fading); (2) small continuous adjustments from emotion.json: sweet warms the colours, mad pulls them toward red-black. Her hair tips follow mad. The code reads this file; tools/emotion_colour.mjs draws it next to the three references.

base.name: 早晨：冷灰蓝
base.why: 卡 20：早上的冷光，主人醒了（她不知道）

base.name: “我执行”：冷
base.why: 卡 22 第 5 声：分支被读过她，那一格闪回卡 8 的冷灰蓝（被倒掉的那段聊天的颜色）

base.name: 更新：红黑
base.why: 卡 22：大插画裂开，回到红黑

emotion._doc: k = value/10. warm(sweet) mixes toward warmBg/warmAccent; red(mad) starts above madFrom and mixes toward redBg/redAccent. tips = mix(her tips, redAccent, mad/10).

fades.name: 体温降到 0：她的蓝慢慢褪淡发白（`23` 新巧思 2，`24` D4）
fades._doc: from `from` to `to` the colours mix toward bg/accent by up to max (eased); held until the next base switch
